setup:
/* Invented sample data: a made-up training subtitle file and a still video of a made-up slide. */window.__vtt="WEBVTT

1
00:00:01.000 --> 00:00:04.200
Welcome to Safe Lifting at Work.

2
00:00:04.400 --> 00:00:08.600
In this module, you learn how to lift
and carry loads safely.

3
00:00:08.800 --> 00:00:12.900
Many injuries at work happen
during everyday lifting tasks.

4
00:00:13.100 --> 00:00:16.800
Before you lift, stop and plan the lift.

5
00:00:17.000 --> 00:00:21.400
Check the weight of the load.
Can you lift it on your own?

6
00:00:21.600 --> 00:00:25.200
Clear a path to where the load must go.

7
00:00:25.400 --> 00:00:29.600
Stand close to the load,
with your feet apart.

8
00:00:29.800 --> 00:00:33.900
Bend your knees, and keep
your back straight.

9
00:00:34.100 --> 00:00:37.800
Get a firm grip, then lift
smoothly with your legs.

10
00:00:38.000 --> 00:00:42.200
Keep the load close to your waist
as you move.

11
00:00:42.400 --> 00:00:46.100
Do not twist your back.
Turn with your feet.

12
00:00:46.300 --> 00:00:50.500
Put the load down first,
then adjust its position.

13
00:00:50.700 --> 00:00:54.600
If a load is too heavy,
ask for help or use lifting equipment.

14
00:00:54.800 --> 00:00:58.500
Next, try the lifting checklist.
";window.__webm='';window.__sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));window.__put=(id,file)=>{const dt=new DataTransfer();dt.items.add(file);const i=document.getElementById(id);i.files=dt.files;i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));};window.__sub=async()=>{__put('subFile',new File([__vtt],'safe-lifting-module-1.vtt',{type:'text/vtt'}));await __sleep(400);};window.__vid=async t=>{const v=document.getElementById('video');const b=Uint8Array.from(atob(__webm),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));const m=new Promise(r=>v.addEventListener('loadedmetadata',r,{once:true}));__put('vidFile',new File([b],'safe-lifting-module-1.webm',{type:'video/webm'}));await m;await __seek(t);};window.__seek=async t=>{const v=document.getElementById('video');const s=new Promise(r=>v.addEventListener('seeked',r,{once:true}));v.currentTime=t;await s;await __sleep(250);};window.__tab=n=>document.querySelector('.tab[data-tab="'+n+'"]').click();window.__val=(id,v)=>{const e=document.getElementById(id);e.value=v;e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));};window.__rows=ns=>{const r=document.querySelectorAll('tr.cue .rowsel');ns.forEach(n=>r[n-1].click());};window.__calm=()=>__sleep(3100);window.__none=()=>{const a=document.getElementById('selAll');a.checked=true;a.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));a.checked=false;a.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));};

gallery.caption: The video plays with its captions. You change the words and times of each caption in the list.
gallery.alt: Subtitle Studio with a training video, a caption on the video, a list of captions and a timeline

gallery.caption: If the video is now faster or slower, use the Speed tab to change all the caption times to match.
gallery.alt: The Speed tab set for a video that is 20 percent faster, with the calculated time factor

gallery.caption: Find a word in all the captions, then replace one match or all of them.
gallery.alt: The Find and Replace tab searching for the word load, with 7 matches and the first match selected

gallery.caption: The Translate tab sends the captions to the translation service that you choose. You add your own key.
gallery.alt: The Translate tab with Microsoft Translator selected, Irish as the target language and an empty key field

guides.title: Move all the captions later or earlier

steps.text: To open your subtitle file, select **Open subtitles**.
On the **Timing** tab, type the time in **Amount**. A minus number moves the captions earlier.
In **Unit**, select **ms** for milliseconds or **sec** for seconds.
Select **Shift all**. To move only the captions that you selected, select **Shift selected**.
Check the new times in the **Start** and **End** columns.
Select **Export .vtt** to download the file. For a SubRip (.srt) file, select **Export .srt**.
